name: upsert_entry
description:
Creates or updates an Entry and its attached Aspects in Knowledge Catalog.

Set `allow_missing = true` to upsert (create a new Entry inside a custom Entry Group or Context Set if it does not exist, or update an existing Entry and its aspects in place).

allowMissing.description: Optional. If true, creates the Entry if it does not already exist (upsert). Always set `allow_missing = true` when creating or upserting entries in a custom Entry Group or Context Set. Leave false when updating an existing Entry in a system Entry Group (such as `@dataplex` or `@bigquery`).

aspectKeys.description: Optional. Aspect keys to modify when `update_mask` includes `aspects`.

aspects.description: Optional. Map of aspect keys to their structured JSON data payloads. Key format: `{project_id_or_number}.{location}.{aspect_type_id}` (top-level) or `{project_id_or_number}.{location}.{aspect_type_id}@Schema.{column_name}`. Common system aspects for Context Sets (`dataplex-types.global.*`): - `dataplex-types.global.document`: `{"title": "...", "type": "...", "summary": "..."}` (required on `entryTypes/document` entries; `type` is e.g. `"agent-guide"`, `"asset-Hub"`, `"dataset-Hub"`, `"table-context"`, `"glossary"`, `"queries"`). - `dataplex-types.global.overview`: `{"content": "", "contentType": "MARKDOWN"}` (required on `entryTypes/document` entries). - `dataplex-types.global.queries`: `{"queries": [{"title": "...", "query": "SELECT ...", "description": "..."}]}` - `dataplex-types.global.contacts`: `{"individuals": [{"role": "STEWARD", "name": "...", "id": "[redacted-email]"}]}` - `dataplex-types.global.descriptions`: `{"fields": [{"name": "col", "description": "..."}]}`

deleteMissingAspects.description: Optional. If true, deletes existing aspects not present in `aspects`. Defaults to false.

entryType.description: Optional. Required when creating a new Entry (`allow_missing = true`). Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/entryTypes/{entry_type}` - For Context Set progressive-disclosure nodes (`agents`, `assets`, `documents/...`, `table-context`): `projects/dataplex-types/locations/global/entryTypes/document` - For generic custom entries: `projects/dataplex-types/locations/global/entryTypes/generic`

fullyQualifiedName.description: Optional. Fully qualified name of the Entry (for example, `bigquery:{project}.{dataset}.{table}`).

name.description: Required. Full resource name of the Entry to create or update: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/entryGroups/{entry_group}/entries/{entry_id}` Examples: - Entry inside a Context Set: `projects/my-proj/locations/us-central1/entryGroups/my-context-set/entries/agents` - Representative entry of a Context Set in `@dataplex`: `projects/{project_number}/locations/{location}/entryGroups/@dataplex/entries/projects/{project_number}/locations/{location}/entryGroups/{context_set_id}`

parentEntry.description: Optional. Resource name of the parent Entry for hierarchical Context Set trees: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/entryGroups/{entry_group}/entries/{parent_entry_id}`

platform.description: Optional. Source platform name (mapped to `entry_source.platform`), for example `"GCP"`.

resource.description: Optional. Canonical source resource URN represented by this Entry (mapped to `entry_source.resource`), for example `projects/{p}/datasets/{d}/tables/{t}` for a `table-context` entry.

system.description: Optional. Source system name (mapped to `entry_source.system`), for example `"BIGQUERY"`, `"VERTEX_AI"`, or `"CLOUD_STORAGE"`.

updateMask.description: Optional. Fields to update when modifying an existing Entry (for example, `["aspects", "display_name"]`).
